sharedRules.name: Bleed
sharedRules.description:
If an attack with this Keyword, shown by the Bleed icon causes any damage but does not cause the target to be removed from play, place a Bleed Token next to the target. No more than one Bleed Token may be placed on a model by a single attack unless a Special Rule states otherwise. A model may have multiple Bleed Tokens. 


Whenever a model with a Bleed Token is Activated, it must take one Endurance Attribute Test for each Bleed Token it has. For each Test that is passed, one Bleed Token is removed. If, after this, the model has any Bleed Tokens left, each time the model performs an Action during this activation, it suffers 1 damage (ignoring Armor rolls) and removes 1 Bleed Token.


If any Bleed Tokens remain at the end of the model’s Activation, they are not removed. If a model becomes Incapacitated while it has any Bleed Tokens, it is immediately removed from play. Remember, a model does not have to perform all of its Actions, or any Actions at all when it is Activated.

sharedRules.name: Fly
sharedRules.description:
Some creatures are able to Fly. This model may choose to Move using its normal Basic Movement Allowance, or by Flying instead. A model that chooses to Fly modifies its Move Action in the following ways:

- The model may move up to 12". This distance cannot be increased by Sprinting.
- The model also ignores terrain and intervening models when moving. However, it may not end its move on top of or overlapping another model, Impassable Terrain, or in Difficult Terrain.


Note: Models within an enclosed space (such as a chamber or house) with a Height Level of less than double [the model's] own Height may not move by Flying.

sharedRules.name: Extra Action
sharedRules.description: This model gains one extra Action in each Activation in which the Keyword applies. A model can never benefit from more than one Extra Action keyword at the same time.

sharedRules.name: Berserker Rage
sharedRules.description: This model begins the game with a single Berserk Token. Once per game, when targeting an enemy with a Melee Attack, this model may discard the Berserk Token to add [BLACK] to the attack roll. A model that has a Berserk Token can never have a Block Token.

sharedRules.name: Born Leader
sharedRules.description: Only one model with this Keyword may be included in your Party. If this model is included in your Party, it must be the Party Champion.

sharedRules.name: Charm Animal
sharedRules.description: Enemy Beasts may not attack this model unless they first pass a Wisdom Attribute Test. In addition, one Beast in this model’s Party may gain the Bodyguard keyword, targeting this model rather than the Party Champion.

sharedRules.name: Cumbersome
sharedRules.description: A Weapon Card with this keyword requires the expenditure of one extra Stamina for each Melee Attack Boost performed while using it. However, if the Power Attack Boost is used while Attacking with this Weapon Card, the bonus Effect Dice is [RED] instead of [YELLOW]. A shield with this keyword requires the expenditure of one extra Stamina when performing the Shield Bash Boost.

sharedRules.name: Cure Disease
sharedRules.description: As a Special Action, this model may target a friendly model within 3” and Line of Sight. That model immediately removes any Diseased Diminishing Effect card currently assigned to it.

sharedRules.name: Death Explosion (Type)
sharedRules.description:
When this model is removed from play, before removing it from the battlefield, first measure an Area Effect 3" from the model. All models, friendly and enemy, within the radius immediately suffer [RED] damage – Armor Ratings may negate damage as
normal, but models cannot discard a Block Token to take a Block Skill Test. This damage normally has a Type (such as Fire) in parentheses.

sharedRules.name: Disease
sharedRules.description: If an attack with this keyword causes one or more points of damage, the target immediately gains a Diseased Diminishing Effect card. A model cannot have more than one Diseased Diminishing Effect Card at any one time.

sharedRules.name: Dragon Infusion
sharedRules.description: This model adds [RED] to its Armor Rating against Melee Attacks from Dragons.

sharedRules.name: Dragon Shouts
sharedRules.description: This model may purchase and use Dragon Shouts as Upgrades.

sharedRules.name: Enchanted
sharedRules.description: An Equipment Card with the Enchanted Keyword already possesses the maximum number of Enchantments and may not be enhanced by attaching further Enchantments unless a Perk allows otherwise. As soon as a Weapon Card receives an Enchantment Attachment, it becomes Enchanted. In addition, all Spells are considered ‘Enchanted’. Enchantment has no innate effect, but a Special Rule may specify an interaction with an Enchanted item, or a certain foe might be resistant to or vulnerable to Enchanted Attacks. The Enchanted Keyword also grants the Magic damage type.

sharedRules.name: Ethereal
sharedRules.description: This model may Move through other models and Impassable Terrain as though they were not there (although it may not end its Move on top of or overlapping them) and adds [RED] to its Armor Rating against non-Enchanted Attacks.

sharedRules.name: Extra Damage
sharedRules.description: Once per round after hitting an enemy with an Attack, this model may add [YELLOW] to the roll.

sharedRules.name: Feeble
sharedRules.description: This model cannot score Critical Hits when performing Attacks. Any roll of [CRITICAL HIT] on the Skill Dice instead counts as a score of 1 and can be modified as usual.

sharedRules.name: Fleet
sharedRules.description: This model has a Basic Move Allowance of 9” rather than 6”.

sharedRules.name: Follow-Up
sharedRules.description: When a Melee Attack with this Keyword is resolved, the Attacker may immediately perform another Attack of the same type (using the same Weapon) against an enemy it is Engaged with. A Follow-Up Attack follows all the normal Melee Attack rules. It is considered part of the same Action (and therefore cannot be Boosted if the same Boost was used in the initial Attack). When performing a Dual Wield Strike, Follow-Ups are completed for each strike in turn – perform Follow-Up Attacks for the Primary Weapon before striking with the Secondary Weapon.

sharedRules.name: Attachment (Type)
sharedRules.description: A card with this Keyword can be ‘attached’ to another item of a specific Type, and does not take up an Equipment Slot of its own (although any Attachment card with an Equipment Slot icon of its own can be equipped in its own right without the need for an attached item). Place it under the attached item to show that it is attached. Attachments can be removed and changed with the Swap Items Action as normal. Each Equipment Slot can only have one Attachment at any time. Attachments may never be assigned to Bound Spells.

sharedRules.name: Bodyguard
sharedRules.description:
This model may never be the Party Champion. As long as this model is Unengaged and not Incapacitated, if the Party Champion is within 3" and Line of Sight of this model, and is targeted by a Ranged Attack, this model may choose to become the target of the Attack, even if they were not in Range or Line of Sight of the Attacker.


In addition, if this model is Unengaged and  not Incapacitated, and within 3" when an enemy ends a Move Action Engaged with the Party Champion, this model must immediately perform a free, out-of-sequence Move Action (even if it has already
Activated this round, and even if it already Moved). This special Move follows all of the normal Move Action rules, but must be towards the Engaged enemy, by the shortest possible route (deviating only to avoid other models and Impassable Terrain). If possible, this Move must end in base contact with the Engaged enemy (thus, Engaging the model at the end of the Move). Once this Move is completed, play immediately returns to the usual sequence.

sharedRules.name: Force Without Effort
sharedRules.description: Each time an enemy within 6” assigns a Staggered Token to this model, assign a Staggered Token to the Attacker as well.

sharedRules.name: Gift Of The Gab
sharedRules.description: This model may add [GREEN] to all Speech Skill Tests.

sharedRules.name: Histskin
sharedRules.description: Argonians only. As a Special Action, this model may restore 1 Health lost earlier in the game.

sharedRules.name: Immunity (Type)
sharedRules.description: This model has Immunity to a specific damage type. They disregard all damage inflicted of the specified Type, and never receive a token or Diminishing Effect card of that type. If a model gains Immunity (Type), remove all tokens of that type from it.

sharedRules.name: Imperial Luck
sharedRules.description: Imperial Heroes only. Once per game, before rolling the Skill Dice, this model may declare use of this ability to automatically score 1 on the test (this score may still be modified).

sharedRules.name: Incapacitate
sharedRules.description: If an Attack with this Keyword causes one or more damage, but does not reduce the target to less than one Health, the target must pass an Endurance Attribute Test or become incapacitated. If a model would be forced to make an Endurance Attribute Test as a result of damage from this Attack, it is instead removed from play.

sharedRules.name: Invisible
sharedRules.description: Line of Sight cannot be drawn to this model by any means. This Keyword ceases to apply as soon as the Invisible model performs an Attack or Engages an enemy.

sharedRules.name: Lightweight
sharedRules.description: When a Weapon Card with this Keyword is used as a Secondary Weapon, the attack ignores the Skill Dice penalty.

sharedRules.name: Linebreaker
sharedRules.description: A model or Attack with this with this keyword removes an enemy Block Token upon a successful Melee Attack test.

sharedRules.name: Magicka Boost (X)
sharedRules.description: A Spell with this Keyword may be Boosted when cast by using up to X Magicka (in addition to the Spell’s Magicka Cost). This keyword is always accompanied by an additional effect, describing what happens when the extra Magicka is used. If the Magicka Boost value is [INFINITY], as much Magicka as remains may be expended.

sharedRules.name: Mounted
sharedRules.description: This model rides to battle on the back of a steed of some description. A Mounted model is treated as a single model for all rules purposes, and any bonuses gained from the mount are incorporated into the model’s Attributes and Special Rules [... see BRB pg. 89].

sharedRules.name: Muffled
sharedRules.description: When this model is Hidden, enemy models must add +2 to their Intelligence Attribute Tests when rolling to Detect it.

sharedRules.name: Night Eye
sharedRules.description: In scenarios using the Darkness rules, a model with this Keyword can see an extra 6”.

sharedRules.name: Poison
sharedRules.description:
A model that suffers at least one point of damage from an Attack with this Keyword and the Poison Icon must place a Poison Token on its Character Card. Place an unnumbered Health, Stamina, or Magicka Token matching the type of Poison used on the Poison Token. 

If a model has any Poison Tokens at the start of its Activation, it loses 1 Health for each Health Token on the Poison Tokens, 1 Magicka for each Magicka Token on the Poison Tokens, and 1 Stamina for each Stamina Token on the Poison Tokens.

All of the damage of the same type is inflicted at once, so, if multiple Poison Tokens with Health Tokens on them cause a Hero to lose their last point of Health, only one Endurance Attribute Test for Injury is made. Poison Tokens can only be removed by the Aid Action.

sharedRules.name: Piercing (X)
sharedRules.description:
Attacks with this Keyword negate X Successes from the target’s Armor roll.
Note: Strong Armor (X) cannot be negated by Piercing (X). [See BRB pg. 89 for example].

sharedRules.name: Ponderous
sharedRules.description: This model has a Basic Move Allowance of 4” rather than 6”.

sharedRules.name: Prowler's Profit
sharedRules.description: This model gains 1 bonus VP each time it successfully picks a lock.

sharedRules.name: Punishing (X)
sharedRules.description: When an Attack with this Keyword reduces a Hero or Adversary Master to less than one Health, the target must modify its Endurance Attribute Test for Injury by +(X).

sharedRules.name: Regenerate Health
sharedRules.description: This model restores one lost Health point at the end of each Round, unless it is Incapacitated. [Does not stack, confirmed by Modiphius designer].

sharedRules.name: Regenerate Magicka
sharedRules.description: This model restores one lost Magicka point at the end of each Round, unless it is Incapacitated. [Does not stack, confirmed by Modiphius designer].

sharedRules.name: Regenerate Stamina
sharedRules.description: This model restores one lost Stamina point at the end of each Round, unless it is Incapacitated. [Does not stack, confirmed by Modiphius designer].

sharedRules.name: Relentless
sharedRules.description: This model can never receive a Staggered Token. If it would be assigned a Staggered Token as a result of Injury, it simply remains in play with 1 Health and no token. If a model gains Relentless while it has a Staggered Token, remove the Staggered Token.

sharedRules.name: Resistance (Type)
sharedRules.description:
This model has a Resistance to a specific Damage Type. They add [RED] Armor Rating against Attacks of that Type. If a model would ever be assigned a Token that it is Resistant to (i.e. Fire or Poison), it must take an Endurance Attribute Test. If the Test is passed, no Token is assigned.

If a model ever has two or more Resistance types, it can only use one of these Resistances to add to its Armor Rating. This is most commonly seen against magical Attacks that have multiple Damage Types.

sharedRules.name: Sailor's Repose
sharedRules.description: Each time this model is successfully targeted by a Spell or Potion that restores lost Health; it restores 1 bonus Health.

sharedRules.name: Shambling
sharedRules.description: This model may never Sprint.

sharedRules.name: Shapeshift (X)
sharedRules.description:
A model with this Special Rule has a second Character Card detailing its alternate form (where 'X' is the name of the alternate form Character Card).


As a Special Action once per round, a model with the Shapeshift Keyword can shift between its forms. Replace the original model's Character Card with the alternate form Character Card and replace the model [...] in the exact same position on the battlefield [...].


A model’s Reserves are transferred between the two forms. If one form has a higher maximum value in any pool than the other when the model Shapeshifts, it must be reduced accordingly so as to not exceed the [new] maximum value.


If a model that starts a Scenario with a Hero Character Card Shapeshifts, and their Character Card is replaced with a Follower Card, that model is still considered to be a Hero. [see BRB p. 91 for full explanation].

sharedRules.name: Slow To Fire
sharedRules.description:
Weapons with the Slow to Fire Keyword receive a Special Token to show they must
be reloaded each time they are fired. After a weapon with this Keyword is used to make
an Attack, place a Special Token on the Weapon Card used. A Weapon Card with a Special Token may not be used to make an Attack. During a model’s Activation, it may use a Special Action and spend 1 Stamina to remove the Special Token from a Weapon card with this Keyword.

sharedRules.name: Slowed
sharedRules.description:
A model may receive a Slowed Token as a result of a magical effect, or by receiving
damage from an Attack with the slowed Keyword. The slowed effect is applied in addition to a Weapon’s Damage Type (if any). A model with one or more Slowed Tokens reduces its Basic Movement allowance by -2” per token ( to a minimum of 0”). A model with the Fly Special Rule also applies this penalty to their Fly Move. The penalty is always incurred after any bonuses to the Basic Move Allowance have been applied. If a model has any Slowed Tokens, it removes one Slowed Token at the end of each Activation.

sharedRules.name: Soul Charges (X)
sharedRules.description: Items with this Keyword (notably Staffs) begin the game with a limited number of Soul Charges, equal to X. This is marked on the Upgrade Card by means of Soul Charge Tokens, which are used to track expended Charges much like a model’s Reserves. One Soul Charge is expended each time the item is used (some items allow the expenditure of additional Charges to increase the effects). Soul Charges may never be increased  above the starting value (X).

sharedRules.name: Staggered
sharedRules.description: A model with a Staggered Token cannot use Stamina Boosts of any kind. In addition, an Attacker gains a bonus -2 modifier to the Attack roll when targeting a model with a Staggered Token with a Melee Attack.

sharedRules.name: Teeth and Claws
sharedRules.description: When this model makes a Melee Attack while Unarmed, it uses the Teeth and Claws card instead of the Unarmed card (pg. 130 [BRB]).

sharedRules.name: Terrifying
sharedRules.description: This model prompts a Morale Check for any enemy model that wishes to Engage it. It also prompts a Morale Check for any model it makes a Melee Attack against. Models with this Keyword are immune to this effect.

sharedRules.name: Turn Undead (X)
sharedRules.description: When a Target Undead model with a Wisdom value of X or less suffers one or more points of damage from an Attack with this Keyword, it immediately Flees. No Morale Check can be taken to avoid this effect.

sharedRules.name: Two-Handed Block
sharedRules.description:
A model with an item with this Keyword Equipped may perform the Block Action (and gain a Block Token) even if they do not have a Shield.


 A model that has a Block Token but does not have a shield Equipped, does not add [YELLOW] to its Armor Rating. A model with an item with this Keyword Equipped may
discard the Block Token whenever it is targeted by a Melee Attack to take a Two-Handed Skill Test. On a successful Test, add [YELLOW] to this model’s Armor Rating for the duration of this Attack.

If a model with a Block Token and no Equipped shield loses or Unequips all weapons with this Keyword, the token is removed.

sharedRules.name: Waterbreathing
sharedRules.description: This model treats areas of Difficult and Impassable Terrain that are water-based (swamps, rivers, ponds, etc.) as Normal Terrain.

sharedRules.name: Weakness (Type)
sharedRules.description: This model has a Weakness to a specific Damage Type. They suffer 1 additional damage whenever they lose one or more Health from an Attack of the specified Type. At least one damage must be caused in order for the extra damage to be inflicted.

sharedRules.name: Path of Might
sharedRules.description:
Heroes from the Path of Might may Equip and use any Melee Weapon, Shield, or Armor Upgrade cards, even if they do not possess the required Skill. When required to perform a Skill Test of the associated type, they may make the corresponding Attribute Test instead. Remember that Attribute Tests do not trigger bonuses from [CRIT] rolls on the Skill Dice.

Strength Attribute: Block, One-Handed, Two-Handed
Endurance Attribute: Light Armor, Heavy Armor, Smithing

sharedRules.name: Path of Shadow
sharedRules.description:
Heroes from the Path of Shadow may use the Archery Skill, Sneak, Lockpick, and Pickpocket even if they do not possess the associated Skills. When required to perform a Skill Test of the associated type, they may make the corresponding Attribute Test instead. Remember that Attribute Tests do not trigger bonuses from [CRIT] rolls on the Skill Dice. In  addition, models from this path add [RED] to their Sneak Attacks instead of [YELLOW].

Agility Attribute: Archery, Lockpicking, Pickpocket, Sneak

sharedRules.name: Path of Sorcery
sharedRules.description:
Heroes from the Path of Sorcery may Equip and use any Spell Card, even if they do not possess the required Skill. When required to perform a Skill Test of the associated type, they may make the corresponding Attribute Test instead. Remember that Attribute Tests do not trigger bonuses from [CRIT] rolls on the Skill Dice.

Intelligence Attribute: Alteration, Conjuration, Destruction, Illusion
Wisdom Attribute: Alchemy, Enchanting, Restoration, Speech

sharedRules.name: Perk: Bullseye
sharedRules.description: When this model inflicts 1 or more points of damage with a Ranged Weapon, the target loses [YELLOW] Stamina.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Armsman
sharedRules.description: This model adds [YELLOW] to its Melee Attacks with One-Handed Weapons.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Bladesman
sharedRules.description: This model adds [GREEN] to its Melee Attack[s] with Swords.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Bonebreaker
sharedRules.description: This model adds [GREEN] to its Melee Attack[s] with Maces.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Critical Charge
sharedRules.description: If this model performs a Melee Attack with a One-Handed Weapon after performing a Move Action in the same Activation, it adds [RED] to the Attack.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Defensive Posture
sharedRules.description: When Equipped with a One-Handed Weapon, if this model is successfully hit by an enemy Melee Attack, this model may use 1 Stamina to force the Attacker to reroll the Skill Test.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Dual Savagery
sharedRules.description: When this model performs a Dual Wield Strike, it adds [YELLOW] to the extra strike with the Secondary Weapon.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Fighting Stance
sharedRules.description: When this model spends a Ready Token to make a Melee Attack with a One-Handed Weapon, it adds [GREEN] to the Attack.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Flurry
sharedRules.description: When this model is Equipped with two One-Handed Weapons and rolls a [CRIT] on a Melee Attack, it may immediately perform a Follow-Up (see [BRB] p.88) with the same Weapon instead of adding [BLACK] to the attack. Only one Follow-Up may be gained this way per Weapon in a single Activation.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Hack and Slash
sharedRules.description: This model adds [GREEN] to its Melee Attacks with War Axes.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Low Slash
sharedRules.description: Melee Attack Boost. When declaring an attack with a One-Handed Weapon, this model may spend 1 Stamina to add the Slowed Keyword to the Attack.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Paralyzing Strike
sharedRules.description: When this model declares a Melee Attack with a One-Handed Weapon, the Weapon gains the [HELMET] Special Effect: Incapacitate, for the duration of the Attack, in addition to any other Special Effect already listed.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Puncture
sharedRules.description: Melee Attack Boost. When attacking with a Sword, this model may spend 1 Stamina to add the Bleed Keyword to the Attack.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Sword and Board
sharedRules.description: When this model is Equipped with both a Sword and a Shield, it may spend a Block Token when making a Melee Attack with the Sword to add [GREEN][YELLOW] to the Attack.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Twin Slashes
sharedRules.description: When this model is equipped with two One-Handed Weapons, it may add [BLACK] to any Melee Attack with the Primary Weapon instead of performing an extra strike with the Secondary Weapon.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Critical Shot
sharedRules.description: This model's ranged attacks gain the Piercing (1) Keyword. If the Attack already has the Piercing rule, the Piercing value is increased by 1 to a maximum of Piercing (3).

sharedRules.name: Perk: Eagle Eye
sharedRules.description: This model increases the Long Range of any Ranged Weapon it uses by 6”.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Hasty Retreat
sharedRules.description: When this model successfully Withdraws from Engagement, it may immediately Shoot as a Free Action with a Ranged Weapon, even if it has already Attacked this round.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Hunter's Discipline
sharedRules.description: This model never runs out of Special Ammunition.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Long Shots
sharedRules.description: Shoot Attack Boost. When Attacking at Long Range, this model may spend 1 Stamina point to add [YELLOW] to the Attack.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Overdraw
sharedRules.description: This model adds [YELLOW] to its Ranged Attacks with a Bow.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Power Shot
sharedRules.description: Shoot Attack Boost. When this model makes an Attack with a Bow at Short Range, the Weapon gains the [HELMET] Special Effect: Stagger.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Quick Shot
sharedRules.description: This model may perform two Shoot Actions with the same Bow in a single Activation.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Ranger
sharedRules.description: When it is Engaged, this model may exchange an Equipped Bow for another Weapon in its inventory as a Free Action.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Steady Hand
sharedRules.description: When performing an Aimed Shot Boost, this model may add [YELLOW] as well as [GREEN] to the Attack.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Augmented Flames
sharedRules.description: Any Destruction Spell cast as an Attack by this model that causes Fire Type damage adds [YELLOW] to the attack.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Destruction Mastery
sharedRules.description: This model adds [GREEN] to all Destruction Skill Tests.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Disintegrate
sharedRules.description: When this model makes an Attack with a Destruction Spell that causes Shock Type damage, the Attack gains the Punishing (1) Keyword. If the Attack already has the Punishing Keyword, the Punishing value is increased by 1 to a maximum of Punishing (3).

sharedRules.name: Perk: Augmented Shock
sharedRules.description: Any Destruction Spell cast as an Attack by this model that causes Shock Type damage adds [YELLOW] to the attack.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Augmented Frost
sharedRules.description: Any Destruction Spell cast as an Attack by this model that causes Frost Type damage adds [YELLOW] to the attack.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Deep Freeze
sharedRules.description: Any Destruction Spell cast by this model that causes Frost Type Damage gains the Incapacitate Keyword.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Avoid Death
sharedRules.description: The first time each game this model is forced to take an Endurance Attribute Test as a result of Injury, it does not need to roll, and treats the result as [CRIT].

sharedRules.name: Perk: Impact
sharedRules.description: When this model inflicts any damage with a Destruction Spell, the target gains a Staggered Token.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Impulse
sharedRules.description: When this model suffers damage, and is not removed from play or Incapacitated, choose an enemy model within 3” of it. The enemy model suffers [RED] damage with the Force Damage Type (reduced by Armor Rating as normal).

sharedRules.name: Perk: Intense Flames
sharedRules.description: When this model causes an enemy model to gain a Burning Token as a result of an Attack with a Destruction spell, the enemy model must take a Morale Check.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Rune Master
sharedRules.description: This model doubles the Range at which its Rune Spells can be placed.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Regeneration
sharedRules.description: Any Restoration Spell cast by this model that restores Health restores an extra [YELLOW] Health to the target.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Agile Defender
sharedRules.description: This model adds [YELLOW] to the Armor Rating of any Light Armor it has Equipped.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Annulment
sharedRules.description: When this model has Light Armor Equipped, it may make a Light Armor Skill Test as a Special Action. If the Test is passed, it gains the Resistance (Magic) Keyword until the end of the round.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Custom Fit
sharedRules.description: When this model has Light Armor Equipped, it may make a Light Armor Skill Test each  time it is targeted by an Attack. If successful, add [YELLOW] to the Armor Rating versus that Attack.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Deft Movement
sharedRules.description: When this model has Light Armor Equipped, it gains -1 to Agility Attribute Tests.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Evocation
sharedRules.description: This model gains the Regenerate Magicka keyword while it has Light Armor Equipped.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Prodigy
sharedRules.description: This model adds [GREEN] to all Skill and Attribute Tests taken to cast Spells while it has Light Armor Equipped

sharedRules.name: Perk: Wind Walker
sharedRules.description: This model gains the Regenerate Stamina Keyword while it has Light Armor Equipped.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Necromage
sharedRules.description: The Magicka cost of all Spells cast by this model [is] reduced by 1 if the target is Undead (to a minimum of 0).

sharedRules.name: Perk: Force Siphon
sharedRules.description: If an Attack [made by this model] causes Damage, the enemy model must make a Wisdom Attribute Test. If they fail they lose 1 Health and the caster immediately restores 1 Health.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Grand Healing
sharedRules.description: Each time this model restores 2 or more Health to itself or a friendly model with a Staff or Restoration Spell, all friendly models within 3” restore 1 Health.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Recovery
sharedRules.description: This model can use a Special Action to restore [RED] Magicka to itself.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Respite
sharedRules.description: Any Restoration Spell cast by this model that restores Health also restores [YELLOW] Stamina to the target.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Restoration Mastery
sharedRules.description: This model adds [GREEN] to all Restoration Skill Tests.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Dark Souls
sharedRules.description: All Zombies summoned by this model are summoned with one extra Health.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Ward Absorb
sharedRules.description: If this model has a Ward Spell Equipped [after casting it], it restores 1 Magicka to itself each time it is successfully hit by an enemy Attack (whether or not the Attack causes damage).

sharedRules.name: Perk: Atromancy
sharedRules.description: All Atronachs summoned by this model add [YELLOW] to their Armor Rating.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Conjuration Mastery
sharedRules.description: This model adds [GREEN] to all Conjuration Skill Tests.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Soul Stealer
sharedRules.description: Each time this model damages an enemy with an attack from a Bound Weapon, it restores 1 Soul Charge to an Equipped item with the Soul Charge Keyword.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Elemental Potency
sharedRules.description: All Atronachs Summoned by this model gain one extra Action in their first Activation.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Mystic Binding
sharedRules.description: This model’s adds [YELLOW] to Melee Attacks with Bound Weapons.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Necromancy
sharedRules.description: Any Spell cast by this model that Summons Zombies does not receive an Upkeep Token. The Zombies remain in play until [this model] is removed from play, chooses to end the Spell, or casts the same Spell again.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Oblivion Binding
sharedRules.description: If this model damages an enemy Summoned creature with a Bound Weapon, it may choose to cancel all damage inflicted. Instead, the target creature is treated as a friendly model (under the control of this model's player and not requiring Upkeep to be paid) until the end of the creature’s next Activation, after which it reverts to the control of the caster [who originally Summoned the creature].

sharedRules.name: Perk: Summoner
sharedRules.description: This model doubles the Range of Summoning Spells it casts.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Twin Souls
sharedRules.description: This model may have up to two Summoned creatures in play at any time.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Alteration Mastery
sharedRules.description: This model adds [GREEN] to all Alteration Skill Tests.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Atronach
sharedRules.description: This model restores +1 Magicka whenever it is the target of a Spell.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Mage Armor
sharedRules.description: As long as this model has no Armor Equipped, it gains an Armor Rating of [RED].

sharedRules.name: Perk: Stability
sharedRules.description: Each time this model must pay 1 Magicka for a Spell’s Upkeep, take an Alteration Skill Test. If successful, no Magicka is expended, and the Spell remains in play.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Fire Enchanter
sharedRules.description: When this model makes an Attack with a weapon that has an Enchantment that causes Fire Damage, add [YELLOW] to the Attack.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Storm Enchanter
sharedRules.description: When this model makes an Attack with a weapon that has an Enchantment that causes Shock Damage, add [YELLOW] to the Attack.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Frost Enchanter
sharedRules.description: When this model makes an Attack with a weapon that has an Enchantment that causes Frost Damage, add [YELLOW] to the Attack.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Extra Effect
sharedRules.description: This model may attach up to two Enchantments to a single Weapon or Armor Card.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Smithing (Type)
sharedRules.description:
When using a Weapon made of a specific material (i.e., Steel, which will always be listed in the Weapon name [or on the Weapon card]), this model adds [GREEN] to the attack.


[Per FAQ v1.2, all Skyforge Weapons count as Steel for the purposes of this perk]

sharedRules.name: Perk: Arcane Blacksmith
sharedRules.description: When this model adds an Enchantment Card to a Weapon, it may choose to add either [GREEN] or [YELLOW] each time it Attacks with that Weapon.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Alchemist
sharedRules.description: Each time this model uses a Potion or Poison Card, take an Alchemy Skill Test. If the test is passed, the card is not discarded.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Benefactor
sharedRules.description: Any Potion with a Diminishing Effect used by this model remains at the final stage of the effect for one additional round.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Concentrated Poison
sharedRules.description: When this model applies Poison to a Weapon, add [RED] to the next Attack performed with that Weapon.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Experimenter
sharedRules.description: Each time this model draws a Treasure or Master Treasure Card, it may make an Alchemy Skill Test. If the test is successful, this model restores 1 point of Health, Stamina or Magicka (player’s choice).

sharedRules.name: Perk: Physician
sharedRules.description: Potions that restore Health, Stamina, or Magicka used by this model (either on itself or as an Aid Action) restore [YELLOW] additional points.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Snakeblood
sharedRules.description: This model gains Resistance (Poison).

sharedRules.name: Perk: Intimidation
sharedRules.description: This model may use a Special Action to become Terrifying until the end of the round.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Merchant
sharedRules.description: When this model draws an Upgrade Card from the Treasure Deck, it may discard the card to gain 1 VP.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Poisoner
sharedRules.description: When this model causes a Poison Token to be assigned to an enemy, add one additional token of the same type to the Poison Token.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Bribery
sharedRules.description: This model may discard any one Equipment Card when performing a Speech Skill Test to add [GREEN] to the test.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Persuasion
sharedRules.description: This model may perform the Rally Command Action even if it is not the Party Champion. In addition, when it does so, this model and the initial target model each restore 1 Stamina.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Expert Locks (X)
sharedRules.description: When this model attempts to pick a lock, the Complexity is reduced by X, to a minimum of 1.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Golden Touch
sharedRules.description: Each time this model successfully Searches a Treasure Token or Master Chest, it gains 1 VP.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Locksmith
sharedRules.description: This model adds [GREEN] to its Lockpick Skill Tests.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Treasure Hunter
sharedRules.description: When this model searches a Treasure Token, it may draw an extra Treasure Card. This Perk does not apply to Master Chests.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Wax Key
sharedRules.description: This model automatically succeeds in opening Locked Doors.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Battle-Rush
sharedRules.description: When performing a Melee Attack with a Two-Handed Weapon, this model restores 1 Stamina for every 3 points of damage inflicted on the target. This Perk is cumulative with the Absorb Stamina keyword.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Barbarian
sharedRules.description: This model adds [YELLOW] to its Melee Attacks with Two-Handed Weapons.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Champion's Stance
sharedRules.description: This model adds [GREEN] to Melee Attacks with Two-Handed Weapons when spending a Ready Token.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Deep Wounds
sharedRules.description: When this model makes a Melee Attack with a Greatsword, the Attack gains the Punishing (1) Keyword. If the Attack already has the Punishing rule, the Punishing value is increased by 1 to a maximum of Punishing (3).

sharedRules.name: Perk: Limbsplitter
sharedRules.description: When this model makes a Melee Attack with a Battleaxe, the Attack gains the Punishing (1) Keyword. If the Attack already has the Punishing rule, the Punishing value is increased by 1 to a maximum of Punishing (3).

sharedRules.name: Perk: Momentum
sharedRules.description: When performing a Melee Attack with a Two-Handed Weapon, this model restores 1 Health for every 3 points of damage inflicted on the target.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Skullcrusher
sharedRules.description: When this model makes a Melee Attack with a Warhammer, the Attack gains the Punishing (1) Keyword. If the Attack already has the Punishing rule, the Punishing  value is increased by 1 to a maximum of Punishing (3).

sharedRules.name: Perk: Devastating Blow
sharedRules.description: When this model scores a Critical Hit on a Melee Attack with a Two-Handed Weapon, it gains a bonus [YELLOW] in addition to [BLACK].

sharedRules.name: Perk: Great Critical Charge
sharedRules.description: When this model performs a Melee Attack with a Two-Handed Weapon after performing a Move Action in the same Activation, it adds [RED] to the Attack.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Sweep
sharedRules.description: When Attacking with a Two-Handed Weapon, if the target is removed from play or incapacitated, this model may immediately make an extra Attack with the same Weapon against a new, non-incapacitated enemy it is Engaged with. Treat this exactly as a Follow-Up (see [BRB] page 88). If the target of this Attack is removed from play or incapacitated as a result of the new Attack, choose another non-incapacitated enemy this model is Engaged with and Attack again, and so on, until this model is no longer  Engaged with any non-incapacitated enemies or makes an Attack which does not  incapacitate or remove an enemy model from play.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Uppercut
sharedRules.description: Melee Attack Boost. When Attacking with a Two-Handed Weapon, this model may use 1 Stamina to add the Force Damage Type to the attack.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Warmaster
sharedRules.description: This model does not have to pay the additional Stamina cost for Power Attacks for Two-Handed Weapons with the Cumbersome Keyword. This model still gains the [RED] dice [from performing a Power Attack affected by the Cumbersome Keyword].

sharedRules.name: Perk: Cutpurse
sharedRules.description: When this model performs a Pickpocket Skill Test, it may choose not to take an item, but instead gain 1 VP.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Extra Pockets
sharedRules.description: This model has one extra Quick Slot (make sure the extra card is clearly separate from the model’s Inventory).

sharedRules.name: Perk: Light Fingers
sharedRules.description: This model adds [GREEN] to its Pickpocket Skill Tests.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Night Thief
sharedRules.description: This model gains -2 to its Pickpocket and Sneak Skill Tests when the Darkness scenario rules are in effect.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Perfect Touch
sharedRules.description: When this model performs a Pickpocket Skill Test, it may add the target’s Equipped items to the draw pile (remember to put all items back in the correct slots when the Pickpocket Action is finished).

sharedRules.name: Perk: Poisoned Pocket
sharedRules.description: When this model performs a Pickpocket Skill Test, it may choose not to take an item, but instead place a single Poison Token on the target (choose a Health, Stamina or Magicka token to put on the Poison token as normal).

sharedRules.name: Perk: Misdirection
sharedRules.description: This model can choose which Upgrade Card to Pickpocket instead of drawing randomly.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Conditioning
sharedRules.description: While Sprinting, this model counts as wearing no Armor for the purposes of calculating its movement, no matter the actual type of Armor it has Equipped.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Constitution
sharedRules.description:
While it has Heavy Armor Equipped, this model may take a Heavy Armor Skill Test as
a Special Action. If the Test is passed, the model restores 1 point of its choice of Health, Stamina, or Magicka.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Cushioned
sharedRules.description: This model treats Falling Damage as if it were 1 Height Level lower if it has Heavy Armor Equipped.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Fists of Steel
sharedRules.description: This model adds [YELLOW] to Unarmed Attacks if it has Heavy Armor Equipped.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Invulnerable
sharedRules.description: When this model has Heavy Armor Equipped, it may spend a Ready Token when it is Attacked to add [BLACK] to its Armor Rating until the end of the current round.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Reflect Blows
sharedRules.description: When this model has Heavy Armor Equipped and survives an enemy Melee Attack without being incapacitated or removed from play, it may make a Heavy Armor Skill Test, rolling its Armor Rating as though it were a Melee Attack, targeting the enemy that Attacked it. No Special Effects can be applied to this Attack. The enemy model may defend itself as normal.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Juggernaut
sharedRules.description: This model adds [YELLOW] to the Armor Rating of any Heavy Armor it has Equipped.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Revitalize
sharedRules.description: Once per round, when this model suffers any damage while it has Heavy Armor Equipped, it may take a Heavy Armor Skill Test. If the Test is passed, this model adds [YELLOW] to all of its Attacks until the end of the round.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Tower of Strength
sharedRules.description: When this model has Heavy Armor Equipped, it may take a Heavy Armor Skill Test each time it would be assigned a Staggered Token. If the test is successful, the Staggered Token is ignored [i.e., removed]. If a model gains Tower of Strength while Staggered, remove the Staggered Token.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Well Fitted
sharedRules.description: When this model has Heavy Armor Equipped, it may take a Heavy Armor Skill Test each time it is Attacked. If successful, add [RED] to its Armor Rating for the duration of that Attack.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Block Runner
sharedRules.description: This model may Sprint while it has a Block Token.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Deadly Bash
sharedRules.description: If this model successfully performs the Shield Bash Boost, the attacker suffers [=[YELLOW][YELLOW] damage. Armor Rating is deducted as normal.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Deflect Arrows
sharedRules.description: This model may spend a Block Token to defend against a Ranged Attack, exactly as if defending against a Melee Attack. Note: It may not Shield Bash.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Disarming Bash
sharedRules.description: After this model successfully performs a Shield Bash against an enemy Hero, it may make a Strength Attribute Test. If successful, the target of the Shield Bash must choose one Equipped Melee Weapon of their choice, if they had one, and flip it face-down. The Weapon may not be used while it is face-down. The model must spend an Action to turn the Weapon face-up again. Note that only Melee Weapons may be flipped, never a Bound Weapon or other Spell.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Elemental Protection
sharedRules.description: While this model has a Block Token, it gains Resistance (Fire, Frost, Shock).

sharedRules.name: Perk: Fortress
sharedRules.description: While this model has a Block Token, it adds [RED] to its Armor Rating instead of [YELLOW].

sharedRules.name: Perk: Power Bash
sharedRules.description: If this model performs a Shield Bash, the target is pushed directly away as if it had been damaged by an Attack with the Force [Damage] Type.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Quick Reflexes
sharedRules.description: Each time this model spends a Block Token, as long as it is not Incapacitated, it may take a Block Skill Test. If successful, the Block Token is not removed and may be used again.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Shield Charge
sharedRules.description: Move Boost. When this model has a Shield Equipped, it may nominate a target enemy in Line of Sight and within its maximum Move Distance (including the Sprint distance if it has any Stamina), taking Terrain into account. This model then moves in the most direct route possible into base contact with the target enemy. It may Move through intervening enemy models (it still may not end its move overlapping another model’s base). If this move successfully ends in base contact with the target enemy, every enemy model moved through en route [to the target] with a Strength value lower than this model’s Strength receives a Staggered Token.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Shield Wall
sharedRules.description: This model gains [GREEN] to its Block Skill Tests while it has a Shield equipped.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Assassin's Blade
sharedRules.description: When this model makes a Melee Sneak Attack with a Dagger, it adds [GREEN] to the Skill Test.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Backstab
sharedRules.description: This model gains one extra [YELLOW] on its Melee Sneak Attacks.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Caltrops
sharedRules.description: Once per game, this model may drop Caltrops as a Special Action. Until the end of the Round, any enemy model that moves within 3" of this model must pass an Agility Attribute Test or end its Move immediately. Models with the Fly Keyword are immune to this effect.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Deadly Aim
sharedRules.description: This model gains one extra [YELLOW] on its Ranged Sneak Attacks.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Light Foot
sharedRules.description: When this model is affected by any type of Trap Event, it may take an Agility Attribute Test. If the Test is passed, this model is not affected by the Trap (if it is an Area Effect Trap, other models within the Area of Effect will still be affected).

sharedRules.name: Perk: Shadow Warrior
sharedRules.description: If this model is Unengaged, it may perform the Hide Action even if there are enemies within 6” and Line of Sight.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Silence
sharedRules.description: When this model is Hidden, enemy models add +2 to the Attribute Test when rolling to Detect it (this is cumulative with the Muffled Keyword).

sharedRules.name: Perk: Silent Roll
sharedRules.description: This model may Sprint while Hidden.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Stealth
sharedRules.description: This model adds [GREEN] to its Sneak Skill Tests.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Timely Escape
sharedRules.description: When this model successfully Withdraws, it may Hide as a Free Action if it meets the criteria [for Hiding].

sharedRules.name: Perk: Illusion Mastery
sharedRules.description: This model adds [GREEN] to all Illusion Skill Tests.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Animage
sharedRules.description: This model adds +1 to the maximum Wisdom restriction of Illusion Spells when targeting Beasts.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Hypnotic Gaze
sharedRules.description: This model adds +1 to the maximum Wisdom restriction of Illusion Spells when targeting Followers, Minions, and Elite Adversaries.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Quiet Casting
sharedRules.description: This model may use Illusion Spells while Hidden without the need for a Sneak Skill Test.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Master Of The Mind
sharedRules.description: This model reduces the Magicka cost of all Illusion Spells by -1 (to a minimum of 0).

sharedRules.name: Perk: Aspect of Terror
sharedRules.description: Any Illusion Spell cast by this model that causes the target to Flee adds +2 to the maximum Wisdom restriction.

sharedRules.name: Perk: Kindred Mage
sharedRules.description: This model adds +1 to the maximum Wisdom restriction of the targets when casting Illusion Spells.

sharedRules.name: Scatter
sharedRules.description:
When a Skill Test fails while using an Attack with the Scatter Keyword, it deviates from the intended target to a new location. [...] The distance of the scatter is equal to the amount by which the modified Skill Dice result failed, to a maximum of 6". [...] If a [FAILURE] is rolled, the scatter distance is 6".


The direction in which the scatter goes is random. To determine the direction, take the
Advantage Token and physically flip it onto the battlefield as if tossing a coin. The direction of the scatter is shown by the arrow.


If the line from the Attacker to the new target location passes through any Terrain, the effect is resolved where the line contacts the Terrain [see BRB pg. 93].

sharedRules.name: Area Effect (X")
sharedRules.description: Any Attack with the Area Effect rule is accompanied by a range in inches (X”), which indicates the radius of the Area Effect... [see BRB pg. 93]

sharedRules.name: Damage Type: Fire
sharedRules.description: If an attack of the Fire type causes any damage but does not cause the target to be removed from play, the target gains a Burning Token. A model may only have one Burning Token at any time. A model with a Burning Token can Activate and perform Actions as normal. However, if a model has a Burning Token at the start of its Activation, it suffers 1 damage (with no Armor Roll). [...]  If a model with a Burning Token ever becomes incapacitated, it is removed from play.[see BRB pg. 94].

sharedRules.name: Damage Type: Force
sharedRules.description:
If an Attack of the Force type causes any damage but does not cause the target to be removed from play, the target model is moved in a straight line directly away from the Attacker (on a line drawn center-to-center between both models’ bases). The distance
moved is equal to the damage inflicted plus a roll of [BLACK] in inches. Sometimes, an additional bonus distance will be specified by the Attack [...see BRB pg. 94].

sharedRules.name: Damage Type: Frost
sharedRules.description: If an Attack of the Frost type causes any damage but does not cause the target to be removed from play, the target cannot use any Boosts until the end of its next activation. This can be tracked by placing a spare token next to the model. If the target had a Burning Token, the Burning Token is removed.

sharedRules.name: Damage Type: Magic
sharedRules.description:
The Magic Damage Type inflicts no extra effects, as usually magical Attacks will also confer one of the 3 elemental Damage Types (Fire, Frost, or Shock). The Magic Damage Type is unique in that Magical Attacks can be both the Magic Damage Type and one
additional Damage Type. All Spells and Dragon Shouts gain the Magic Damage Type and the Enchanted Keyword in addition to any other Damage Types listed on their card

sharedRules.name: Damage Type: Shock
sharedRules.description: If an Attack of the Shock type causes any damage but does not cause the target to be removed from play, the target gains a +2 modifier to all Alteration, Conjuration, Destruction, Illusion and Restoration Skill Tests until the end of its next activation. This can be tracked by placing a spare token next to the model.

sharedRules.name: Limited Use Abilities [X]
sharedRules.description:
A model’s character card may include a Keyword, Perk or Special Ability followed with a number in Square Brackets [X]. These rules are Limited Use Abilities meaning they can only be used the amount of times shown within the bracket.
Unless a rule states that the Limited Use is [X] per action, per round or per game all Limited Use Abilities default to [X] per activation.

sharedRules.name: Template (X)
sharedRules.description:
A Template Attack is a special ranged attack, which has its range defined by a teardrop-shaped template of width X”. When performing the attack, do not declare a target, place the narrow end of the template in contact with the attacker’s base and position the wide end directly away. There must be at least one non-hidden enemy model in clear or obscured Line of Sight at least partially under the template (You may roll to detect Hidden models as normal). Once the template is positioned, roll an attack separately against every model at least partially under the template unless that model is behind LoS Blocking terrain of at least an equal Height Level to the attacker. Cover applies as
normal to obscured models.

sharedRules.name: Adversaries And Wards
sharedRules.description:
Some Adversaries prefer the use of magic over steel to defend themselves. If an Adversary’s Defense slot shows they have a Ward Equipped (where it would usually state Shield), when it performs a response that instructs it to Block, it instead casts a Ward. This is always successful, and a Block Token is assigned to the activating Adversary model. In addition to the standard rules for models with a Block Token (page 32), casting a Ward grants the Resistance (Magic) Keyword (page 90) to the caster until the Block Token is discarded. Adversaries may not gain more than one Block Token from Wards.


The Adversary discards the Block Token as normal against the first successful incoming Melee Attack. When the Block Token is discarded, immediately perform a Restoration Skill Test. On a success, the Ward’s Block Rating is added to the Adversary’s Armor Rating against the incoming Attack. A model that gains a Block Token because of a ward may never perform a Shield Bash using that token.

sharedRules.name: Agent Ability
sharedRules.description: At the start of the game, each Nightingale model must choose one of the three Nightingale Agent cards - [Agent Of] Stealth, [Agent Of] Subterfuge, or [Agent Of] Strife. No more that one of each card can be included in the same Party. The effects last for the duration of the game.

sharedRules.name: Clinical Strike
sharedRules.description: Dark Brotherhood models performing Melee Attacks with weapons with the Lightweight keyword may test against their Agility Attribute rather than Strength.

sharedRules.name: Contract Killers
sharedRules.description:
After deploymeny, assign a Black Hand Contract card to half the enemy Heroes or Master Adversaries, rounding up.  If you remove these models as casualties, gain an additional 2VPs in addition to any VPs specified by the scenario.
If playing against the Dark Brotherhood as Adversaries, assign contract cards as described above to the models from the Player party - these are primary Objectives on the Response Matrix.

sharedRules.name: Fortune Hunters
sharedRules.description: The party Champion and all friendly Faction Heroes and Followers within 3" treat Search as a Free Action.

sharedRules.name: By Ancient Right!
sharedRules.description: Models from this Party within 3” of an Objective or Special Objective add [YELLOW] to their Armor Rating. In addition, if this Party ever contests control of an Objective, they automatically win it instead.

sharedRules.name: Enemies of Molag Bal
sharedRules.description: All Aldmeri Dominion Heroes add [YELLOW] to their Attacks versus models with the Followers of Molag Bal Faction icon.

sharedRules.name: Victory Through Unity
sharedRules.description:
[A Daggerfall Covenant] Party’s Heroes benefit from the following special rules:
-Any Hero in the Party may target any model in the Party with a Rally action (for example, a Faction Hero may target a Hireling).
-When performing an Aid action, a Hero may target Staggered models, and may use the Aid action to remove a Staggered token.

sharedRules.name: Stubborn
sharedRules.description: While the Party Champion is engaged, that model and all friendly models within 3” automatically pass any Morale test they are required to take.

sharedRules.name: Wrathful
sharedRules.description: If the Party Champion is removed from play by an enemy, then for the remainder of the game all Heroes in the Party gain [GREEN] to attack rolls against the model that removed the Champion.

sharedRules.name: Armies of Unlife
sharedRules.description: As a Special Action, any Hero in the Party may target a friendly Undead or Vampire model within 6” and LoS. That model restores your choice of 1 Health, Stamina, or Magicka.

sharedRules.name: Shield Drill
sharedRules.description: When the Party Champion performs a Block Action, friendly Followers with Shields within 3" may be assigned a Block Token.

sharedRules.name: Might Of Arms
sharedRules.description: While the party Champion is engaged, that model and all friendly Followers within 3" gain the Linebreaker keyword.

sharedRules.name: Dragonslayers
sharedRules.description: All Blades models add [YELLOW] both to their attacks versus Dragons and to their Armor Rating when targeted by a Dragon's attacks or enemy Dragon Shouts.

sharedRules.name: The Bigger They Are...
sharedRules.description: Blades models gain the Piercing (1) keyword for any melee attack against models at least double their own Size [correction: Height]. If the attack already has the Piercing keyword, increase the value in the parentheses by 1.

sharedRules.name: Elves
sharedRules.description: The Altmer, Bosmer, and Dunmer make up the ancient kindreds of Elves across Tamriel. In addition, their dark and twisted kin, the Falmer, bear a common ancestry, though it pains other Elves to admit it. If ever a Special Rule applies to ‘Elves’, it applies to all four of these races.

sharedRules.name: Hirelings
sharedRules.description: Any model (Hero or Follower) from a different faction that is able to be included in the Party is called a ‘Hireling’. Normally, these will be models with the Adventurers or Neutral faction icons. Hirelings cannot benefit from their Party’s Faction Special Rule and can never use the Party Champion’s Wisdom value for Morale Checks.

sharedRules.name: Special Ammunition
sharedRules.description: Some Ranged Attacks make use of special or finite ammunition (such as arrows which are ‘Attached’ to a Bow Weapon Card or Throwing Knives). To represent the risk of running out, each time the ammunition is used, roll [SKILL DIE]. If the player rolls a [FAILURE], the card must be discarded. On any other roll, they continue using the item as normal. In the case of Attached ammunition, it is only the Attachment card that is discarded, not the Weapon that fired it – it's assumed the model has a reserve of ‘normal’ ammunition as a backup.

sharedRules.name: Jarl's Justice
sharedRules.description: Any Hold Guard model within 3" of the party Champion that would gain [GREEN] for outnumbering an enemy model also adds [YELLOW] to melee [attacks].

sharedRules.name: Bound Armor
sharedRules.description: Bound Armor is a subtype of Personal Spell. As a Special Action, a Hero model may cast the Spell, targeting itself. Spend the Magicka, and take the Skill Test, with the usual Difficulty modifier. If the Test is successful, Equip the Bound Armor to the Body Slot – any Upgrade Card already Equipped to the Body Slot is placed in the model’s Inventory. [...] While the Spell is Equipped to the Body Slot, the Bound Armor is used exactly like a normal Armor Card [...] Skill Tests using Bound Armor use the Light Armor or Heavy Armor Skill [... see BRB pg. 56 for full description]

sharedRules.name: Bound Weapon
sharedRules.description:
A Bound Weapon is a subtype of Personal Spell. As a Special Action, a Hero may cast the Spell, targeting itself. Spend the Magicka, and take the Skill Test, with the
usual Difficulty modifier. If the Test is successful, Equip the Bound Weapon to a Hand Slot – any item(s) already Equipped to the chosen Hand Slot(s) is placed in the
model’s Inventory. [...] Melee Attacks with a Bound Weapon use the One-Handed or Two-Handed Skill [...] Ranged Attacks with a Bound Weapon use the Archery Skill [...] Unlike Melee and Ranged Attack Spells, Bound Weapons may benefit from Boosts when Attacking, just like ordinary Weapons. The Caster must pay the Stamina cost as normal [see BRB pg. 55 for full description].

sharedRules.name: Upkeep
sharedRules.description: A Spell with this Keyword remains in play if the caster pays an upkeep cost in Magicka. The same Spell may not be cast again until the previous iteration has ended (see [BRB] page 54).

sharedRules.name: Ward
sharedRules.description:
A Ward is a subtype of Personal Spell and is effectively a magical Shield. As a Special Action, a Hero model may cast the Spell, targeting itself. Deduct the Magicka cost, and take a Skill Test, with the usual Difficulty modifier.If the Test is successful, Equip the Ward to a Hand Slot [...]The model also gains a Block Token.

While the model has a Block Token, the Special Rules on the Ward Card are in effect (for example, Lesser Ward provides the caster Resistance (Magic) as long as the Block Token is assigned). The Block Token can be spent as normal to gain the Block bonus to Armor Rating. If the model does not have the Block Skill, it makes a Strength Attribute Test instead. An active Ward cannot be used to Shield Bash.


Unlike normal shields, a model may Equip a Ward to each Hand Slot, forgoing offensive capability in exchange for defense [...]. A model so Equipped may perform a Block Action while it already has a Block Token. This is the only way that a model can possess two Block Tokens at the same time[... see BRB pg. 57].

sharedRules.name: Summon
sharedRules.description:
Summoning Spells are subtypes of Environment Spells. When a Spell with this subtype is successfully cast, it results in a model being placed on the board, in accordance with the Environment Targeting Types Rules. These models (or Summoned Creatures) are treated exactly like friendly Followers while the Spell has an Upkeep Token. Summoned Creatures cannot be placed in base contact with an enemy model when first Summoned, but may otherwise be placed anywhere within Range of the Caster.

When a Summoned Creature appears, it must Activate as soon as the caster’s Activation is complete, ignoring the usual sequence of play. In subsequent rounds, the creature activates as a normal member of the Party, with the exceptions noted below [in BRB].

Unless otherwise specified, Summon Spells receive an Upkeep Token – unlike normal Upkeep, 1 Magicka must be paid each time the creature Activates, not the Caster. The Upkeep is not paid in the Round in which the creature is Summoned. [... see BRB pg. 56].

sharedRules.name: Spells And Shouts
sharedRules.description: A model can choose a number of Spell Cards equal to its Intelligence Attribute, or a number of Shout Cards equal to its Strength Attribute. A model can select both Spells and Shouts if it has the option available. If there is no room to equip these at the start of the game (or if the card requires an Action to equip), they are held in the model’s Inventory instead.

sharedRules.name: Equipment Skill Restriction
sharedRules.description: Many Upgrade Cards display a prominent Skill, which is tested against when the card is used. Unless a special ability or Perk allows otherwise, a model must have the specified Skill in order to Equip the Upgrade Card in one of their Upgrade Slots [or be of the correct Path, see BRB pg. 20 and 106].

sharedRules.name: Familiar
sharedRules.description: Familiars are a special type of Follower. [...] Players may choose no more than one Familiar for every Hero in their Party.

sharedRules.name: Subrace
sharedRules.description: A subrace is an extension of the 10 Races of Tamriel. [...] Any rules or keywords associated with the Subrace are used in addition to any gained from the 10 Races of Tamriel. If a race already has Resistance or Weakness to a damage type from their racial keywords, they cancel each other out and neither keyword is used. Additionally, if a model already has a Keyword then the same keyword gained via a Subrace cannot be gained again. Some profiles may have a Subrace as the only listed race listed, in this instance that profile only uses the Subrace abilities.

sharedRules.name: Adversary Shapeshift (X)
sharedRules.description: [...] 'X' is the name of the alternate form Advesary Card. [...] Each time this Adversary activates, roll [SKILL DIE]. On a [FAILURE], the model transforms into the alternate form, replacing the model with the alternate version. [...] An Adversary's Reserves (if any) are transferred between the two forms. If one form has a higher maximum value in any pool than the other when the model Shapeshifts, it must be reduced accordingly so as to not exceed the maximum value. Repeat this same process for the alternate form when it next activates [see BRB p. 85 for full explanation].

sharedRules.name: Dawnguard Armor
sharedRules.description: This model adds [YELLOW] to its Armor Rating against any damage inflicted by an enemy Vampire.

sharedRules.name: Dawnguard Weapon
sharedRules.description: This Attack inflicts an extra [YELLOW] damage against Vampires.

sharedRules.name: Strength in Numbers
sharedRules.description: Bandit Followers add [GREEN] to their Melee Attack rolls when there are more friendly models than enemies within 3".

sharedRules.name: Damage Type: Sun
sharedRules.description: n addition to all the effects suffered by the Fire Damage Type, attacks of the Sun Damage Type add an additional [RED] against models of the Undead Race or Vampire Subrace. Additionally, Undead or Vampire models cannot equip Weapons or Spells that have the Sun Damage Type. If an attack with the Sun Damage Type is performed against a model that is not Undead or a Vampire, those models add [YELLOW] to their Armor Rating when attempting to reduce incoming Damage.

sharedRules.name: Vampire Perk: Detect Creatures
sharedRules.description: As a Special Action, this model may spend any number of Stamina points to remove Hidden Tokens from enemy models within 6" and Line of Sight at a cost of 1 Stamina point per Hidden Token removed.

sharedRules.name: Vampire Perk: Embrace of Shadows
sharedRules.description: As a Special Action, this model may spend 1 Health point to gain the Invisible keyword until the start of its next activation.

sharedRules.name: Vampire Perk: Mist Form
sharedRules.description: As a Special Action, this model may spend 2 Health points to gain the Ethereal keyword until the start of its next activation.

sharedRules.name: Vampire Perk: Night Cloak
sharedRules.description: As a Special Action, this model may spend 1 Health point to make enemy models suffer a +2 penalty to Attack Tests that target this model until the end of the round.

sharedRules.name: Vampire Perk: Poison Talons
sharedRules.description: Melee Attack Boost.  This model may spend 1 Stamina point during a Melee Attack with Teeth & Claws to add the Poison (Health) keyword [to the Attack].

sharedRules.name: Vampire Perk: Power Bite
sharedRules.description: Melee Attack Boost.  This model may spend 2 Stamina points during a Melee Attack to add the Bleed and Absorb Health (2) keywords to the Attack.

sharedRules.name: Vampire Perk: Supernatural Reflexes
sharedRules.description: This model may spend 1 Health, 1 Stamina, and 1 Magicka points at the beginning of its Activation to gain the Extra Attack Keyword until the end of its Activation.

sharedRules.name: Strength of the Bloodline
sharedRules.description: Clan Volkihar models may [spend] 1 Stamina point to add [GREEN] to any Blood Magic spell they attempt to cast.  Furthermore, if any Blood Magic test scores a [CRITICAL HIT], the model may immediate restore 1 Health, Magick, or Stamina point to itself or a friendly model within 3", in addition to any other effect[s of the test].

sharedRules.name: Volkihar Thralls
sharedRules.description: The only Hirelings available to a Clan Volkihar Party are non-unique Followers with the Neutral Faction.  Once recruited, these models become Volkihar Thralls for the purposes of interacting with other special rules.  They are treated as normal Faction Followers - their faction becomes Clan Volkihar.

sharedRules.name: Vampire Hunters
sharedRules.description: All Dawnguard models add [GREEN] to their Attacks versus Vampires.  Furthermore, Dawnguard models add [GREEN] to any Morale check they are required to take if there are one or more enemy Vampires in play.

sharedRules.name: Dawnguard Recruits
sharedRules.description: Friendly Hirelings in a Dawnguard Party benefit from their own Faction special rule as well as the Vampire Hunters special rule.  In addition, as an execption to the usual rules for Hirelings, they may use the Party Champion's Wisdom [Attribute] for Morale Checks as if they were from the same Faction.

sharedRules.name: Immovable
sharedRules.description: This model cannot be moved via the Force Damage Type while it has a Block Token.

sharedRules.name: Aggressive Assault
sharedRules.description: When [this model] rolls [CRITICAL HIT] on the Skill Dice when performing a Melee Attack, add an additional [YELLOW] to the standard [BLACK] for rolling a critical.

sharedRules.name: Entourage (MODEL) (X)
sharedRules.description: This model always begins the game accompanied by X models of the specified type, which are included in its septim cost. The Entourage models must be deployed at the same time as this model, within 3" of it. If this model is a Party Champion, all members of the Entourage have the Bodyguard keyword. If this model is an Adversary that begins play in the Spawn Pool, its Entourage will only deploy when this model Spawns. The Entourage models are counted as a single Adversary for Spawning and for Activating via drawing a Number Token. The Activation of one Entourage model is always completed before starting another.

sharedRules.name: Ghostly Strike
sharedRules.description: This model adds the Enchanted and Piercing (1) keywords to its Unarmed Melee Attacks.

sharedRules.name: Gladewalker
sharedRules.description: This model treats areas of Difficult Terrain that are woodland-based (forests, jungle, dense undergrowth, etc.) as Normal Terrain. Decide before the game which terrain pieces in play are eligible.

sharedRules.name: Signature Loot (X)
sharedRules.description: At the start of the game, this model equips the specified Treasure card (X) - the card’s Septim value is included in the model’s own cost. When this model is removed as a casualty by means of a Melee Attack,  the attacking model immediately gains the specified Treasure card. If the model is an Adversary Master, the card is not equipped, but this effect replaces the usual random Treasure card draw for removing the model as a casualty.

sharedRules.name: Guardians of Ancient Treasures
sharedRules.description: Draugr never acquire Treasure Cards during play (searched Treasure and Master Treasure tokens are still removed from play). If a Draugr model is instructed to gain a Treasure or Master Treasure Card, they instead gain [YELLOW] VP for their side and restore 1 point to a Reserve of their choice.

sharedRules.name: Limited Shouts
sharedRules.description: Many Draugr Heroes may use Dragon Shouts.  However, they are limited to only [purchasing/equipping] Disarm, Frost Breath, or Unrelenting Force.

sharedRules.name: Mysterious Purpose
sharedRules.description: When drawing Event Cards, Draugr Parties follow all [SPAWN] and [INCIDENT] instructions as usual, but ignore [RADIANT QUEST] and [SPECIAL QUEST]. Furthermore, Draugr parties do not use the usual Quest deck, they must use the special Draugr Quest deck instead. [These have a centered Draugr faction symbol on the front side].

sharedRules.name: Shield-Brethren
sharedRules.description: Companions Heroes add [GREEN] to any Morale check they are required to take if there is at least one other friendly Companions Hero is within 6".

sharedRules.name: The Skyforge
sharedRules.description: Companions Heroes reduce the Septim cost of any Skyforge Steel equipment cards by 1.

sharedRules.name: The Circle
sharedRules.description: Note that the ability to transform into a Werewolf in no way affects the Companions' hierarchy. The Party [Chamption] still remains so even in Werewolf form, and rules that target the Party [Champion] (such as Bodyguard) remain unchanged regardless of the leader's form.

sharedRules.name: Directed Study
sharedRules.description: When the Party Champion successfully casts a Spell, all friendly Heroes within 6" add [GREEN] to their Skill Tests when casting Spells for the remainder of the round.

sharedRules.name: Magical Nexus
sharedRules.description: When the Party Champion rolls [POTION] during a successful Skill Test, all other friendly College of Winterhold Heroes within 6" immediately restore 1 Magicka point.

sharedRules.name: Inquisitors
sharedRules.description: Thalmor Heroes add [GREEN] to all Skill and Attribute Tests while there are one or more Incapacitated enemies within 3".

sharedRules.name: Talos Hunters
sharedRules.description:
All Thalmor models may reroll score of [CRIT FAIL] when performing a Melee Attack against an enemy that meets any of the following criteria:
- Has 'Talos' as part of its Name or Subtitle
- Has an equipped Amulet of Talos
- Is currently subject to a Blessing of Talos
- Has the Dragon Shouts keyword

sharedRules.name: Eyes on the Prize
sharedRules.description: The first time a Hero from this faction rolls a [CRIT] for any Lockpicking or Pickpocket Skill Test, immediately gain 1 bonus VP.

sharedRules.name: Shadowmarks
sharedRules.description: At the start of the game, after setup, the Thieves' Guild player may replace one Treasure Token on the board with a Master Treasure Token. If for any reason there are no Treasure Tokens in play, the Thieves' Guild may place one Master Treasure Token, following the normal rules for placing Objectives. When a Thieves' Guild model searches a Master Treasure Token, draw three cards from the deck and choose which to take. Reshuffle the remainder back into the deck.

sharedRules.name: Damage Type: Physical
sharedRules.description: All damage is Physical unless a rule specifically states otherwise. There are no special rules covering Physical damage.

sharedRules.name: Dragons and Movement
sharedRules.description: In every even-numbered round, beginning in round 2 (so rounds 2, 4, 6, and so on), this model gains the Fly keyword for the duration of any Move or Fall Back Response it is required to take. This also applies to any Ancient Dragon and Mirmulnir.

sharedRules.name: Talos Guide You
sharedRules.description: As a Special Action, target one friendly model with the Dragon Shouts keyword within 3" and line of sight. That model restores 1 Thu'um.

sharedRules.name: Slow to Anger
sharedRules.description: As soon as this model or a friendly Giant or Mammoth within 6" takes any damage, this model's Attitude becomes Agressive for the rest of the game.

rules.name: Candlelight Spell Clarification
rules.description: [I believe RAI here is referring to lighting a circle around the caster with a 3" radius, but awaiting an official ruling. In addition, it is intentional that the only cost of this spell is the Upkeep cost].

modifiers.value: The Silver Hand models can never join Party with Werewolf or Shapeshift(Werewolf)

selectionEntries.comment: not possible to implement party restrictions

modifiers.value: Adventurer Party Composition restrictions not supported by app

rules.name: Adventurers Party Composition
rules.description: No more than half (50%) of the models in the Party may be from the same path, unless it is the same path as the Party Champion. Models with the Adventurers faction icon may be included as Hirelings in another Party, unless that Party’s composition restrictions specify otherwise.

modifiers.value: At least 50% of models in Aldmeri Dominion Party must be Heroes

rules.name: Injuries
rules.description:
For each model that was removed as a casualty during the game, you must check to see if it suffers an Injury. First determine what nature of mishap befell the character - Physical Injury, Elemental Injury, or Magical Injury.

Players may either choose one of the Injury Tables on page 8 that most closely matches how the model was removed during the game, OR roll on the table below to randomly determine one. [...]

After you have rolled an Injury, it is added to the model’s entry on the Party Roster. An Injury lasts for the next game that model takes part in, after which it is healed, any keywords gained due to an Injury are lost when that Injury is healed.

rules.name: Optional Rule: Character Death
rules.description: If a model is removed as a casualty, before determining if the model is Injured, first roll the White Skill Dice. If the result on the Skill Dice is a [FAILURE] the model has succumbed to its injuries and has perished. The model has died and cannot be used any more in scenarios with your Party. Otherwise, roll on the Injury tables as normal.

rules.name: Injuries for Heroes and Followers
rules.description: Heroes can suffer any of the five Injuries on a table. Followers can only suffer the top two results. When rolling for a Follower, re-roll any result displaying a Special Effect Icon until an applicable Injury is determined.
